jobs.details: Job Description 1.Assist in the management of local production workers, ensure the transmission of production instructions, and facilitate communication between workers and management. 2.Be responsible for daily attendance records and work completion statistics of local workers, and participate in handling various production issues and disputes. 3.Assist in the education, training, and behavioral management of local workers. 4.Bilingual translation of official documents from Chinese to Arabic. 5.Providing on-site interpretation services between Arabic and Chinese. 6.Filing and managing various documents related to work (electronic/paper versions). 7.Completing other tasks assigned by the manager. 8.Inspection and control of production, processing, assembly, quality, and civilized production. Job Requirements • Bachelor's degree in Chinese linguistics. • Professional experience as a Translator. • Fluent in English. • Proficient in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint). • Strong time-management abilities. • HSK4 or equivalent certificate.
